# Actor channel bunches

## Status

Experimental: older server 25621760/client 25793767 and 3.0.31 capture
(F-704 to F-711, F-761, F-845); visibility: server 26313077 (F-1020).
Last reconciled: 2026-11-19.

## Scope

Actor framing/scheduling after control admission: exports, partials, spawn/content,
close/dormancy, relevancy/priority/readiness and visibility RPCs.
Function bindings are in the cited finding/evidence IDs.
Before restructure: c2e76dc:docs/specs/network/actor-channel.md

## Confirmed

- Restart/profile/backend F-1036/F-1039/F-1041/F-1048; query118/callback126
  F-1051; fields66/86 F-1052 (no visibility ACK). Framing/partial bounds
  F-1043/F-1046/F-1047; observation limits F-1042/F-1045.

- For 3.0.37, F-1277 binds tags, F-1278 selected classes and F-1279 row widths.
  An empty table shifts 131 indices. Client entry and level instances remain open.
  F-1280 to F-1282 bind selected 3.0.37 receive/send operands and the conditional
  enum width. Handle selection, caller consumption and live state remain open.
- F-1197 public-server 26613688 retains F-1193's spans/declaration. Ordered
  `UFunction*&`, `FFunctionParams const&` types: M-1477 to M-1485,
  M-1488/ev_8018de4b3bea. Construction consumes descriptors; cached construction
  bypasses them. Counts alone grant no runtime bound. General ABI, traversal,
  immutability, clobber/alias/reentry remain open.
- F-1197 static detail: frozen trace and 908-byte listings F-1247; conditional
  `BP_IcarusPlayerControllerSurvival_C` fields 148/149/150/169 and bound 183
  F-1248; cache-miss ordering F-1249 (export framing is separate). Selected
  listings: 24 starts/2,834 instructions/11,427 instruction bytes; no
  exhaustive flow or live dispatch (M-1493, M-1494).
- Ordinary 149 presence and enum bits, empty 148/150 and `ReceivedRPC`
  consumption F-1250; absent-zero preservation and authored-only enum 6/7
  refusal F-1251. Completed `ReplicatedLeftProspectSession` is property handle
  26, not RPC 26 (F-1252); its checksum-off 20/30-bit encoding F-1253 and codec
  support F-1254; listing coverage F-1255. No full callback/overflow/scheduler or
  live class/cache/archive proof follows.
  Producer-ready/null-PropertyLink, editor/global/CDO and mutation stay open.
  Encoding permits a default-off scoped experiment; F-1177/durability/client
  limits stand.
- Visibility wire, callback/cache contract and inert model: [visibility state](visibility-state.md)
  (F-1020 to F-1024).
- 3.0.32 PlayerData/Bestiary field bounds: 27/8; registered counts: 26/7
  (F-1015). Matched 3.0.34 controller/backend/PlayerData/Bestiary bounds:
  183/149/27/8 (F-1016); static framing only.
- NetGUID references, export flags and checksums: F-850, F-852, F-853.
  Controller/GameState open composition: F-852, F-794; four opens after Join:
  F-784, F-804.
- Authored bridge behavior and limits: F-938 and
  [bridge operations](../../runbooks/native-server.md#network-sessions-experimental).
- Dynamic GUIDs assign on first serialization, by open or reference (F-794);
  components keep one GUID across connections.
- Export repetition: F-796 (`experimental::session_open::ConnectionExports`).
- Component opens/GUID ordering and pawn initial arrays F-854
  (`experimental::actor_open`, `pawn_open`); vitals/inventories F-836
  (`network::pawn_content`); stats F-839 (`pawn_stats`).
- Frozen movement (F-1100): the client pawn has no movement mode while
  replicated `bServerFrozenMovement` or its own terrain-anchor flag is set;
  the native opens it true and, at F-1099's revision, never clears it.
  The client reports its own flag as pawn field 85,
  `ServerUpdateClientFrozenMovement(bool)`: reliable, a 1-bit payload,
  field-index bound 129 from the public server (F-1105, F-1106); the
  original only stores it (F-1108).
- Moves: pawn field 39 in, field 30 good-move acknowledgements out
  (F-1127, F-1128; `experimental::character_move`).
- GameState managers: [world managers spec](world-managers.md) (F-859, F-861,
  F-862).
- GameState open values: active prospect 51..67 and C015 handles 34, 35, 39,
  41, 42, 46 (F-855; arrays carry every element field, `IsCurrentlyPlaying`
  only for connected members); `SessionFlags` 47 (F-830);
  `LockedMissions` 50 (F-1060); `bIsOpenWorldProspect` 48 and
  `bIsOutpostProspect` 49 (F-911); `RichPresenceGUID` 24 (F-912).
- Gameplay-tag indices/hash F-702 (U-065 resolved): lexical ordering,
  invalid=N+1, 12-bit total/first segment; `experimental::tag_dictionary`.
- Exports, partial bunches and must-be-mapped prefixes (F-709 to F-711):
  single/partial limits 7,625/7,624 bits at packet 1024/handler 2 bits;
  constructed size has a separate cap. First/last parts carry initial+open/
  final+close. Receive processes exports before reliable ordering, reassembles
  partials, then reads must-be-mapped GUIDs before content. Export framing and
  sender ordering: F-711; `experimental::sequencing`, `actor_channel`.
- Open bunch, actor hook and dormancy (F-709 to F-711, F-751, F-845, F-849):
  location/velocity quantized, scale unquantized; actor hook empty on AActor,
  one-byte player index on APlayerController. ReplicateActor correspondence
  F-761; dormant cleanup F-710; dormancy transition/flags M-748.
- Content framing/handle order/fast arrays F-644/F-703 to F-709/F-846/F-849
  (`experimental::rep_rpc`, `rep_layout`: 64 schemas). Client subobjects omit
  stably-named bit/class after their reference (F-972). Ordinary field bounds
  depend on the actual class cache, as F-1197 qualifies above.
- Spawn vectors/rotators F-845 (at most 24 quantized bits); property dispatch,
  enum maxima, numeric widths, names/strings/text and struct serializers
  F-847/F-848 (U-064/U-066 resolved). Of 3,960 struct operations, 3,637 recurse
  and 323 serialize directly, including 293 row handles. Earlier codec
  evidence: F-588/F-589/F-593/F-597/F-639/F-673 to F-675/F-704 to F-709/
  F-762/F-843; `experimental::rep_text`.
- Older-build scheduling/relevancy F-745/F-748/F-749/F-751/F-761;
  force-frame F-788/F-851. Static readiness/priority and saturation/tear-off
  rules give no runtime qualification (U-038). Thresholds/defaults:
  [actor_channel.rs](../../../src/experimental/actor_channel.rs).
- GameState update fields/timing F-807/F-810/F-1057/F-1058; unreliable partial
  splitting F-825 (`LabPeer::actor_update_datagrams`).
- `ConnectedPlayers` records (F-1072 to F-1075): a reliable GameState bunch
  carries each class-named `UReplicatedConnectedPlayer` block, then handle 3
  listing their GUIDs; native: F-1077.

- Modifier time (F-991, F-994, F-996): authority rejects equal/unordered
  requests. Quantize f32 `s = seconds * 10`,
  `r = round_ties_even(-0.5 - (s + s))`, then `max(0, -(i32(r) >> 1))`.
  Out-of-range integer/u16 conversion retains wire (fresh restore starts at zero).
  OnRep: F-996; tick and AutoDestroy order: F-994. Listener effects,
  scheduling and refresh remain open (U-069).

- Internal-temperature setter ordering and notification boundary: F-997.
  TemperatureTick (F-999) samples only when elapsed time exceeds the interval,
  consumes one period, then adjusts internal temperature on every admitted call.
  Binary32 fractional state uses asymmetric integer conversion;
  `temperature::tick_temperature` defines the qualified arithmetic. Initial
  values and callee effects remain explicit.

## Candidate

- F-1197 completion candidate: no bound completion RPC; descriptors lack Net.
  No-save selects 4/finalises. Checker tests authority/cancel/pending work.
  Finalisation writes completed state, emits local event/delegate on change,
  clears pending/cancel; Cancel may retain zero without an event. OnRep calls
  that path. Vtable candidates prove no live dispatch; callback/timer/original
  persistence/durability/client effects stay open (M-1488/ev_7386f0c70678,
  M-1488/ev_7481920a03ac, M-1490, M-1491). Failed live leave F-1186 and
  authored adapter F-1188 retain separate scopes; F-1177 stands.

Native modifier and temperature updates share reliable delivery (F-995, F-998).
Explicit temperature/modifier ticks retain connection-local timing (F-1000). No automatic climate,
scheduling or stock-client qualification.

- Authored prospect refresh transport F-936: explicit calls; original trigger
  timing/client behavior remain unqualified (U-070/U-038).
- Replay/scheduling fixtures and randomized checks F-763/F-764; underlying
  framing F-709 to F-711. These qualify authored models only.
- Records: staged updates as fields fill, null controller references on other
  connections, removal without a destroy (F-1073, F-1077; U-038).
- Unfreeze: S2 replicates `bServerFrozenMovement` false once, near its last
  field-82 answer and before per-frame camera updates (F-1099; one 3.0.34
  session), about 20 s after the client reported itself unfrozen (F-1107).
- After entry (S2): client moves are pawn field 39 (F-1129), answered only by
  field-30 acks and rare corrections (F-1130, F-1132; correction layout
  F-1204, codec F-1205); silence does not fault the client (F-1131). A new
  joiner's pawn is moved by the server before the unfreeze and arrives by
  drop pod (F-1134, F-1136); kill-Z is server-only
  (F-1137); native placement F-1138.

## Open questions

- F-1197/F-1188: live class/cache/archive/OnRep/menu behavior, mutable layout,
  complete player-state coverage, restart/rejoin and original durability remain
  open. Conditional encoding permits an explicit default-off experiment only.
- U-079: live visibility bindings/effects and client profile execution remain
  unqualified (F-1034, F-1042, F-1051).

- Authenticated runtime relevancy and priority exercise (U-038).

## Evidence

M-707, M-708, M-813, M-819, M-832, M-841, M-844..M-848, M-1056,
M-1126..M-1129, M-1147..M-1149, M-1197, M-1198, M-1215, M-1217,
M-1219, M-1221, M-1223 to M-1232, M-1327 to M-1330, M-1338 to M-1340, M-1354 to M-1358, M-1371 to M-1374; earlier observations: cited findings. F-1197; M-1459 to M-1462, M-1477 to M-1485, M-1488 to M-1494; M-1498 to M-1501.

# Control negotiation

## Status

Experimental: static observations; the framing and Hello exchange are
wire-validated offline, and a synthetic Login and Join are welcomed (F-688,
F-689, F-712 to F-714, F-858). Scope: dedicated-server build 25621760 (M-168)
unless a current-client (build 25793767) comparison is named.
Last reconciled: 2026-11-14.
Full text: d5b0ae6:docs/specs/network/control-negotiation.md.

## Scope

Server control dispatch, notify tables, packet and bunch headers,
`UControlChannel` byte order, queueing and fallback layouts, admission,
`PreLogin` and join, across both binaries, plus the bounded 3.0.34 S2
Steam-handler exchange. Excludes compression and complete runtime initialization.

## Confirmed

- S2 Steam authentication precedes Hello (F-1007). LSB-first outer bits are
  stateless `0`, auth `1`, then an eight-bit type. Type 1 carries the ticket
  as a hexadecimal FString and the Steam ID as u64; type 2 carries a
  four-byte Boolean. One outer terminator follows, with no connection
  sequence header or connection terminator. The captured Login uses type
  index 3 and the same Steam identity. Native results:
  [control-store digest](../../research/network/control-stores.md) (F-1009).
- Dispatch (F-284, F-757; M-170/E-011, M-170/E-013): a validity check precedes
  table dispatch, and a separate branch serves another operating mode.

  | Inner ID | Branch entry | Meaning |
  | --- | --- | --- |
  | 0 | `0x1439eebec` | Hello: version and token negotiation |
  | 4 | `0x1439ef03b` | `NMT_Netspeed`: clamps `int32 Rate` to `[1800, NetDriver->MaxClientRate (+0x64)]` into `Connection->CurrentNetSpeed (+0x38)` |
  | 5 | `0x1439ef0e0` | `NMT_Login` |
  | 9 | `0x1439ef7f1` | `NMT_Join` |
  | 10 | `0x1439efb8a` | `NMT_JoinSplit` |
  | 15 | `0x1439f031c` | `NMT_PCSwap`: reads `int32 ChildIndex`, resolves the parent or `Children[ChildIndex]`, destroys an unowned `Actor` when `Actor->NetConnection (+0x410) == TargetConn` |
  | 17 | `0x1439f0416` | `NMT_DebugText`: logs an `FString`, no state change |

  Other IDs, including out-of-range ones, reach the common exit.
- Hello reads a token string ([archive-string spec](../save-format/archive-string.md))
  and compares versions ([checksum spec](network-checksum.md)); a nonempty token
  requires an encryption delegate (F-284, F-713, F-758; step F-563).
- Notify tables (F-505, F-724, F-753 to F-755; F-063, F-076, F-088, F-106,
  F-506, F-520, F-544, F-546, F-723; U-007 to U-013, U-015 to U-018, U-043
  resolved): both constructors install primary and `FNetworkNotify` vftables at
  `+0` and `+0x28` (`UWorld` `0x145467ef0` / `0x145468180`, `UPendingNetGame`
  `0x14540a038` / `0x14537cb18`); `TARGET02`
  `0x1439dae50` is `UWorld::~UWorld`. `UWorld::Listen` and
  `UPendingNetGame::InitNetDriver` store `this + 0x28` at `Driver + 0x208`, and
  `NotifyControlMessage` (`0x1439ee7f0`) adjusts `this` by `-0x28`.
- Receive and send path (F-514, F-515, F-518, F-712, F-714, F-740, F-756; U-014,
  U-044 resolved): `UControlChannel::ReceivedBunch` (client `0x1437c4940`, server
  `0x143536420`), while `bNeedsHeaderInspection` (`+0x68`), applies F-756's
  first-bunch check (byte-swap bit `0x20` at `+0x29`), persists
  `Connection + 0x158` (`Data[1] != 1`) and clears `+0x68`. Later `FInBunch` and
  `FControlChannelOutBunch` copy that bit from `Connection + 0x158`. While
  `!Bunch.AtEnd() && State != USOCK_Closed`, ID `22` (`NMT_DestructionInfo`)
  goes to `ReceiveDestructionInfo` (`0x1435354d0` / `0x1437c3d50`, `u8 Reason` +
  `FNetworkGUID`), other IDs to `Notify->NotifyControlMessage`, and unhandled
  messages (`Pos == PosBefore`) to 20 layouts (`0..18`, `21`, `22`; others fail
  closed; `16` closes on `PlayerController` channel failure, `19` logs an
  `FString`, `20` forwards `u8 + FString` to `NetDriver`/`World`/`GEngine`;
  `experimental::control_messages`). `UControlChannel::SendBunch` sends at once
  when `QueuedMessages` (`+0x70`) is empty and `NumOutRec < 255 + bClose`, else
  queues up to `0x7fff` messages and drains them in `Tick` once `bOpenAcked`
  (`+0x30 & 1`).
- Packet and bunch headers (F-521 to F-527, F-688, F-710, F-711, F-714, F-759),
  LSB-first after optional magic-header bits, the stateless-connect bit (`0`) and
  Steam-auth bit (`0`), before the connection and handler termination bits:

  | Order | Field | Encoding |
  | --- | --- | --- |
  | 1 | Packet word | 32 bits: history words minus one (0-3, at most 8), acked sequence (4-17), sequence (18-31) |
  | 2 | Ack history | that many 32-bit words |
  | 3 | Packet info | one bit; if set, jitter below 1024, frame-time bit and, to a client, one frame-time byte (F-843) |
  | 4 | Control | one bit; if set, open and close bits |
  | 5 | Close reason | if closing: value below 15 |
  | 6 | Paused, reliable | one bit each |
  | 7 | Channel index | packed, below the connection's channel limit |
  | 8 | Exports, mapped GUIDs, partial | one bit each |
  | 9 | Reliable sequence | if reliable: below 1024, relative to the channel's last |
  | 10 | Partial initial, final | if partial: one bit each |
  | 11 | Channel name | if open or reliable: one bit; set, a packed index (`<= 702`), else an archive string and 32-bit number (F-843) |
  | 12 | Payload | bit count below `8 * MaxPacket`, then those bits |

- Reliability: sequence seeding, ack history and resend F-759 (steps F-535 to
  F-539); reliable reordering F-710.
- Control vocabulary (F-529, F-530, F-548, F-740, F-758, F-844); strings are archive
  strings and `u32` values follow the Hello byte-swap flag:

  | ID | Direction | Fields |
  | --- | --- | --- |
  | 0 Hello | to server | byte, u32 version, string token |
  | 1 Welcome | to client | strings: map URL, game name, redirect URL |
  | 2 Upgrade | to client | u32 local version, then close |
  | 3 Challenge | to client | string (F-844) |
  | 4 Netspeed | to server | i32 rate |
  | 5 Login | to server | string response (`"0"`, F-548), string URL, unique-net-id (F-844), string platform |
  | 6 Failure | to client | string, then the client closes; shutdown sends it, then a reason-0 control close (F-782) |
  | 9 Join | to server | none |
  | 10 Split join | to server | string URL, unique-net-id |
  | 15 Swap | to server | i32 child index (`-1` parent, `>= 0` splitscreen child) |
  | 16 ActorChannelFailure | to server | i32 channel index (closes if `Ch->Actor == PlayerController`) |
  | 17 Debug | to server | string |
  | 18 NetGUID | to client | packed int, string |
  | 21 Encryption ack | to client | none |
  | 22 DestructionInfo | to client | u8 reason, packed NetGUID (`!= 1`) |

## Candidate

- Native CM hosting separates the default 100 ms socket poll from completed-frame
  decoding, retaining FIFO and fatal malformed/logoff checks (F-1180). A protected
  stock client observed password rejection and correct-password Welcome/Join,
  then stalled before Begin/profile calls (F-1181); no world-entry qualification.
- The `experimental` modules model the confirmed headers, fallback table and
  disconnected loopback negotiation (F-874, F-689, F-712 to F-714, F-858).
- `UWorld::NotifyControlMessage` (F-563, F-713, F-740) and `WelcomePlayer`
  (`0x1439fdeb0`, F-580): `IsClientMsgTypeValid` admits only
  `ExpectedClientLoginMsgType` (`0` Hello, `5` Login) in `ClientLoginState`
  `LoggingIn = 1`, and every non-login ID (`!= 0 && != 5`) in `Welcomed = 2` and `Joined = 3`. On
  `Join` (`9`) with a null `PlayerController` (`+0x30`), `SpawnPlayActor` runs
  `AGameModeBase::Login` -> `ApproveLogin` -> `SpawnPlayerController` ->
  `InitNewPlayer`, sets `NetPlayerIndex` (`+0x3d4`), binds `HandleClientPlayer`,
  calls `PostLogin` and sets `ClientLoginState = 3` (U-010 resolved).
- `PreLogin` (F-712, F-713; U-037 resolved; `experimental::admission`):
  `IsCompatibleUniqueNetId` checks `GetDefaultOnlineSubsystemName()` /
  `CompatibleUniqueNetIdTypes`, and `ApproveLogin` (`0x14385ac60`) checks
  `Server full.` and `Maximum splitscreen players`. In 26425113 ICARUS first
  rejects a wrong `password` option (`Invalid Password`, F-1163).

## Open questions

- Executed runtime dispatch in an authenticated stock-client session (U-038).

## Evidence

- Protected native failure, CM repair and partial retry: M-1411 to M-1414 (F-1180, F-1181).
- S2 handler/Login: M-1164, M-1173 (F-1007); native Join: M-1171 to M-1174.
- Static: M-170 (`icarus-server-baseline`; M-170/E-011, M-170/E-013,
  M-170/E-021, M-170/E-022, M-170/E-024), M-146,
  [research/archive](../../research/archive/2026-10-12-control-caller-limit.md),
  M-023 to M-045 ([control-store digest](../../research/network/control-stores.md)),
  M-589 to M-596, M-749 to M-754, M-763 to M-765, M-770, M-771, M-776, M-777,
  M-780, M-791.
- Tests: `python3 tools/cargo_guard.py test --locked --test protocol control::` and
  `python3 tools/cargo_guard.py test --locked --test protocol peer_lab::`.

# Default version checksum

## Status

Experimental: static interpretation with independent arithmetic tests, one
matching early-startup value, both builds' wire values and exhaustive delegate
cross-reference scans across both binaries (F-689, F-713; U-037 resolved). Scope: build 25621760 (M-168); addresses
are preferred virtual addresses in that file. Last reconciled: 2026-10-22.
Full text: d5b0ae6:docs/specs/network/network-checksum.md.

## Scope

Default version-checksum construction, cache, setter and delegates. Excludes
datagram framing, identity validation and stock-client negotiation. Native
admission does not use this module.

## Confirmed

- Default construction at `0x141f2b220` formats project/version inputs, then
  calls `0x141e28f90` and `0x14139af80`. The transformation lowercases only
  UTF-16 units `A` to `Z`. The checksum consumes each nonzero UTF-16 unit as a
  little-endian 32-bit value, stops at the first zero unit, and complements the
  seed before and the result after processing. All 256 table entries at
  `0x145eed270` equal independently generated reflected CRC-32 entries for
  polynomial `0xedb88320` (F-281).
- The primitive and an independent Python `zlib.crc32` oracle reproduce the
  early checksum **1447163286** for project `Icarus`, version `1.0.0`, NetCL 0,
  EngineNetVer 17, GameNetVer 0. Supplementary characters contribute two
  separately expanded surrogate units, so UTF-32 encoding is not equivalent
  (F-254).
- The log then sets ProjectVersion to `3.0.30.158174-rel-DangerousHorizons` and
  invalidates the cached checksum, so the early value must not be hard-coded as
  the accepted game version (F-254).
- Cache-valid storage is `0x146210cf0`, the cached checksum `0x146210cf4`, and
  the generation/comparison delegates `0x1462116a0` / `0x1462116b0`. Generation
  checks the cache before its callback-enable argument; an uncached call needs
  nonzero occupancy, a nonnull object and a successful virtual predicate.
  Comparison has its own delegate checks, else exact 32-bit equality (F-255).
- Setter `0x141f39000` ignores null/empty strings; nonempty input updates
  project-version storage and clears cache-valid, even when it already points
  at the stored buffer. Caller `0x143996c54` supplies a string from a
  `GeneralProjectSettings` default object (F-255).
- On the wire both builds compare a Hello's version exactly and log it: 3.0.31
  answers its own 2406501229 with a Challenge and 1379612455 with Upgrade,
  3.0.30 the reverse (F-689). A client needs a server of its own build; the
  comparison is the server's, so a native server sets its own policy (F-529).
- Client build 25793767 builds the same string from its own inputs: image
  project name `Icarus`, engine protocol 17, a zero-filled game protocol
  global, and NetCL from `-networkversionoverride=` or the
  `networkversionoverride` console variable, else 0. Hello sends this value
  with the override delegate allowed; the project version is runtime state, so
  a match needs the client's active version (F-541, F-542).
- Exhaustive `.text` RIP-relative and `.rdata`/`.data` pointer scans across both
  binaries prove that `GetLocalNetworkVersionOverride` (`0x1463251b0` /
  `0x1462116a0`) and `IsNetworkCompatibleOverride` (`0x1463251c0` /
  `0x1462116b0`) are referenced only by their reader functions (`0x141f13b30` /
  `0x141f2b220`, `0x141f16ef0` / `0x141f2e6e0`) and CRT `atexit` destructors
  (`0x144800cb0..d10` / `0x14461eb50..b0`), with 0 callbacks bound in either
  binary (F-255, F-713; U-037 resolved).

## Candidate

No additional candidates.

## Open questions

- Authenticated stock-client session against the native server (U-038).

## Evidence

- Private cases: M-146 (`work/control-version-20261012/`, E-001 to E-003, strict

# Stateless handshake framing

## Status

Candidate, wire-observed for the initial exchange and static-verified for prefix,
restart and tolerance rules. Scope: shipping builds 25621760 and 25793767
(M-168, M-770, M-771). Last reconciled: 2026-10-18.
Full text: d5b0ae6:docs/specs/network/stateless-handshake.md.

## Scope

Initial request, challenge, cookie echo/ack, optional `MagicHeader`, 1-byte
restart request and 49-byte extended response. Excludes platform authentication,
version/control negotiation, replication and gameplay admission.

## Confirmed

- Short frame without optional prefix, bit positions from zero, least-significant
  bit first, timestamp little-endian IEEE-754 binary64 (F-280, F-729):

  | Bit offset | Width | Field |
  | --- | --- | --- |
  | 0 | 1 | Handshake marker, one |
  | 1 | 1 | Restart flag |
  | 2 | 1 | Secret selector bit |
  | 3 | 64 | Timestamp |
  | 67 | 160 | Cookie bytes |
  | 227 | 1 | Termination, one |
  | 228 | 4 | Unused padding to 29 bytes |

- The initial client request is 29 bytes: first byte `01`, last byte `08`, all
  others zero (zero restart/selector bits, 28 zero bytes, termination bit).
- The original answered it with a 29-byte challenge (restart false, selector
  true, finite positive timestamp, 20-byte cookie) and, after an echo of the
  issued timestamp, selector and cookie, with a 29-byte acknowledgement
  carrying timestamp `-1.0`, selector one, restart zero and the same cookie,
  logging `Handler Handshake Complete` with Steam authentication inactive
  (F-253, M-169).

# Archive string codec

## Status

Experimental: bounded independent codec with authored tests; original wire
round trip pending. Scope: build 25621760 (M-168) for the original reader, with
supplied-save comparisons on both copies. Last reconciled: 2026-10-22.
Full text: d5b0ae6:docs/specs/save-format/archive-string.md.

## Scope

FString reader/writer, its strict native subset and property adapters reaching
the same reader. Excludes caller-established byte order/framing, UDP, admission
and decoded-value meanings.

## Confirmed

- The reader/writer at `0x141e15db0` uses a signed 32-bit count: zero is empty,
  a positive count measures narrow bytes, a negative count measures UTF-16
  units, and nonzero counts include one terminating unit. `i32::MIN` is rejected
  before negation; a configured archive maximum bounds the absolute count; wide
  units may be byte-swapped by archive flags (F-893; U-026 resolved).
- The reader overwrites the final unit with zero instead of requiring a
  terminator, so a count of one yields an empty string. Narrow conversion at
  `0x1408a91f0` handles ASCII directly and replaces negative signed bytes
  (`>= 0x80`) with the caller's `?` fallback; it is not UTF-8 decoding. The wide
  reader inserts a zero for `U+FFFF` and may shorten the result; `FMemoryReader`
  (`0x140b68ee0`) checks overrun only (`Offset + Num <= Limit`) and sets
  `ArIsError` without requiring exact enclosing-property EOF. The default writer
  selects narrow for ASCII and wide otherwise, a flag can force wide, and the
  narrow helper at `0x1409d1a30` has a replacement path (F-893).
- `FArchive::operator<<(FName&)` (`0x140962300`) deserializes a temporary
  `FString` and calls `FName(WIDECHAR*, FNAME_Add = 1)` (`0x141f66440`):
  `FNameHelper::MakeDetectNumber` (`0x141f65a60`) and `ParseNumber`
  (`0x141f65d70`) split a trailing `_<1..10 digits>` suffix (`0` or non-`0`-prefixed,
  `<= 2,147,483,646`, stored as `Number = value + 1`) and enforce `NAME_SIZE = 1024`,
  hashed via case-preserving/case-insensitive CityHash64 (`0x141f70090`; F-893;
  U-033 resolved; `parse_fname_number_suffix` in `experimental::archive`).
- Successful demand is four count bytes plus the declared narrow byte count or
  twice the declared wide-unit magnitude; zero and magnitude-one cases keep
  their distinct consumption (F-285).
- Concrete adapters reaching this reader (F-285): StrProperty vtable
  `0x144ef2918` virtual `0x90` tailcalls through the 15-byte adapter
  `0x142166670`; the C034 NameProperty descriptor OS01.F08 (generation 20)
  delegates its loading branch to the same reader before internal name
  construction, with no separate numeric-index transfer; the C009 enum-backed
  Byte descriptor PS01.F04 (generation zero, vtable target `0x142158d40`) calls
  the Name/FString path through virtual `+0x140` when loading with an enum
  present, its raw one-byte branch not applying and an optional `+0x170`
  callback adding no transfer; both C009 top EnumProperty descriptors
  (generation 30, vtable `0x144ecb940`, value slot `0x14210a290`) call the same
  path even with a null enum pointer, and the underlying Byte setter adds no
  archive transfer.
- Supplied-save comparisons (structure and consumption only, no text): 486 C009
  S01 Str spans, 14,124 bytes (M-099); 1,658 C034 OS01.F08 Name spans, 14,922
  bytes, 829 nine-byte values per copy (M-108); 486 C009 PS01.F04 occurrences as
  32-byte strict frames plus the parent-child Name/Str frames (M-103).

## Candidate

- `experimental::archive::read_string_frame` validates both explicit byte orders
  without allocating on success, exposing prefix/payload/content/terminator
  spans, counts, encoding and consumed bytes with allocation-free UTF-16 unit
  iteration; `decode_string` materializes units into a `Vec<u16>` when ownership
  is needed, and `parse_fname_number_suffix` mirrors `FName` `_<digits>`
  splitting and `NAME_SIZE = 1024` bounds (F-142, F-893). Neither converts
  invalid surrogates to a Rust `String`; following fields are untouched; empty
  output uses count zero; ASCII is preferred for writing; forced-wide output is
  not implemented (F-142).
- Research cap: 65,536 units including terminator, checked before allocation/
  multiplication. Full-range checks precede output; non-ASCII narrow bytes,
  missing terminators, embedded NUL and `U+FFFF` reject. Error precedence: count/limit/payload, narrow
  ASCII, final terminator, embedded NUL, then `U+FFFF`. These are documented
  strict-reader differences from the original's lossy `?`/zeroing normalization
  (F-893; U-026 resolved).

  | `TotalLength` | `0x20` | Compressed byte count passed to `FCompression::UncompressMemory` |
  | `DataLength` | `0x24` | Redundant copy of `CompressedSize` written by `WriteToProspectBlob` (`0x1418fa200`); unread by `ReadFromProspectBlob` (`0x1418e6240`, F-737) |
  | `UncompressedLength` | `0x28` | Output size passed to `FCompression::UncompressMemory` |
  | `BinaryBlob` | `0x30` | Base64 input string |

- Original decode order: Base64, zlib over `TotalLength` bytes, SHA-1, then
  archive deserialization (F-283, F-737, F-1256 to F-1259).
  Native model: `experimental::restore_rules::evaluate_prospect_blob_decode`.
- All twelve supplied BOM UTF-16LE prospects (eleven distinct) have one
  complete zlib stream, canonical Base64 and `DataLength == TotalLength`.
  Intake and sizes: M-118, F-881. Each lists seven distinct account/character-slot
  tuples including the claimed owner (F-262). Twelve identical 97-byte UTF-8
  documents (`Accolades.json` and 11 backups) match `FAccoladeSaveData`
  (`0x145dc1790` / `0x1419edb20`, size `0xB0`, align `0x08`: empty
  `CompletedAccolades: TArray<FAccoladeCompletedState>` `+0x00`,
  `PlayerTrackers: TMap<FPlayerTrackersRowHandle,int32>` `+0x10`, and
  `PlayerTaskListTrackers: TMap<FPlayerTrackersRowHandle,FTrackerTaskListProgress>`
  `+0x60`; F-738). The release inspector reports `world_imported: false` (F-881), and
  `inspect-save --stage-check --expect-prospect-name` passes all 12 supplied
  prospect files and 3 reference-server re-saves (`15 / 15`, `2,664..2,850`
  recorders, F-738).
- No explicit outer build or save-version marker exists, and neither the
  payload nor the original server's re-save holds a version string (F-896).
- F-1271 measures empty report to save start (120/240 s timers) and C015/root
  clock deltas. F-1272 times native startup to SIGTERM. Whole-recorder matches
  leave identity open. F-1275 compares member, controller and character slot
  keys within categories and retained character UIDs across the saves.
- Dedicated build 26613688 declares a direct C008 array with float32 time
  and signed i32 state per element. Its four direct element fields lack an
  explicit plot ID (M-1593). Native readback of the F-1271 common input
  and both zero-player lobby outputs retained 109
  losslessly typed C008 records per save, each with one exact array element
  and one explicit finite float32/signed i32 pair. M-1595 hashes sorted pairs
  with multiplicity. All three digests differ (F-1274). A direct call passes the
  saved array to an interface entry (M-1597). Each of its two paths has an indirect
  call site. One skips the call on a null receiver. Writer, clock and units remain open.
  All three snapshots share 109 positive top-level saved actor keys, each
  unique within C008. Integer states agree at every key. From input,
  each output has 32 higher floats and 77 bit-identical floats. Comparing
  the 240 s output to the 120 s output gives 14 higher, 18 lower and 77
  bit-identical floats (M-1596).
- Provenance: the heavy-world archive is preserved privately with an inventory
  (M-166); the writes date from the 3.0.29 window, before the user-reported
  3.0.31 client (F-896, F-685, F-878). Possession completes no compatibility,
  bug-reproduction or performance gate.

## Candidate

- Inspector policy (research limits, not recovered ones; F-880): raw input at
  most 4 MiB, declared output at most 32 MiB; UTF-8 or BOM-marked UTF-16LE
  only, rejecting odd UTF-16 lengths and unpaired surrogates; the entire UTF-8
  input is validated before unknown fields are skipped (N-005); exact field
  names and types, duplicates rejected; named objects required at root and
  blob boundaries, positional arrays rejected; malformed-JSON diagnostics keep
  only error category/line/column. It rejects negative lengths and malformed
  SHA-1 or Base64; requires canonical padded Base64, the exact compressed
  count, one complete zlib stream, no trailing bytes and the exact output
  length; verifies the legacy hash without retaining the world; and reports
  `DataLength` without enforcing equality with `TotalLength` (F-737).
  Output labels: `experimental_envelope_only`, `experimental_root_tags_only`
  (fixed research profile, F-882), and
  `experimental_staged_prospect_save_state_only`. Staging
  checks the `FProspectSaveState` root schema, base recorder framing, tag
  order, `PostLoadSerialize` migration, 17 `FProspectInfo` tags and optional
  `ProspectID` matching. It overlays tags on 65-class defaults,
  applies per-recorder `Validate` ([restore rules](restore-rules.md)), and
  counts `C033` `bIsPhysicsDynamic` across all 15 saves (F-680, F-736, F-738,
  F-746, F-747).
- The original reader checks overrun only and normalizes narrow/wide strings
  lossily (`F-893`; U-026 resolved), whereas the strict inspector fails closed;
  the entry-path failure matrix (`LoadProspectByName` vs `SetupLoadedProspect`)
  and `ReadFromProspectBlob` decode contract are verified across missing, empty,
  malformed-JSON, ID-mismatch and corrupt-`BinaryBlob` inputs (`F-899`,
  `F-733`, `F-737`; `U-056` to `U-058`, `U-063` resolved). Schema agreement does
  not establish cross-build compatibility (U-025, U-040).

## Open questions

- Producing-build log confirmation for the supplied save (U-040); official
  restoration and newer-build compatibility (U-025).
- C008 restoration needs plant continuity across saves, validated units and
  state semantics, and per-plot progression measured under matched official
  and native loads and restarts. Aggregate differences leave continuity,
  growth rate, cause and restoration open (F-1274).

## Evidence

- Static: M-169 (`M-169/E-004`, `M-169/E-008`, `M-169/E-009`, `M-169/E-018` to
  `M-169/E-025`, `M-169/E-028` to `M-169/E-030`), M-757, M-758, M-772, M-773,
  M-776, M-777. Supplied-save triage with hashes, CRCs and bounded member
  checks: M-118.
- M-1598/ev_79a8dbcd137a records the provider limitation for M-1597.
- Permissively licensed dependencies and a Rust zlib backend.
- Native admission, diagnostics and source preservation: M-182 and the
  [envelope fixture](../../../tests/fixtures/prospect-envelope.json),
  [parser tests](../../../tests/prospect.rs) and [CLI tests](../../../tests/cli.rs).

# Prospect loading: save dispatch and inner framing

## Status

Experimental; scope dedicated-server build 25621760 (supplied-save build: F-323). Last reconciled: 2026-11-10.
Full text: d5b0ae6:docs/specs/save-format/prospect-loading.md

## Scope

Prospect-load entry paths, `ProspectSaveState` version fixups/dispatch,
recorder/base-component and C013/C028/C034/C009/D01 framing in both copies. Envelope: [envelope](prospect-envelope.md); tags:
[tagged properties](tagged-properties.md); strings: [archive strings](archive-string.md);
restoration: [restore rules](restore-rules.md). Not covered: gameplay data-table
row meanings, reference resolution and world import.

## Confirmed

Entry paths and failure reporting

- By name (F-899, F-733, F-737; U-057, U-063 resolved): `LoadProspect`
  (`0x14146e590`) -> `LoadProspectByName` rejects empty names, strips `.json`
  case-insensitively, reads it via `GetProspectBlob` (`0x141817bd0`) and
  `GetProspectInfo` (`0x14181e530`), and calls `TransitionToProspect`; missing,
  malformed-JSON and ID-mismatch inputs return `false` with state kept. A corrupt
  inner `BinaryBlob` fails in `ReadFromProspectBlob` *after*
  `ResetActiveProspect` (`0x1418333b0`) and `SetActiveProspectInfo`
  (`0x141837100`) overwrite the active `ProspectInfo`.
- From file (F-899, F-733; U-056, U-058, U-063 resolved):
  `SetupLoadedProspect`, called from `InitGame` (`0x1414acc40`) with
  `?LocalSavePath=`, logs Fatal at `0x1414bb15f` when a header or state load
  fails, before `ResetActiveProspect`.

Inner state, version and archive mode

- State and header registration and sizes: F-889. Reflected
  `FProspectInfo` (F-738; `0xa0` B) carries `ProspectID` `+0x00`,
  `ClaimedAccountID` `+0x10`, `ClaimedAccountCharacter` `+0x20`, `ProspectDTKey`
  `+0x28`, `FactionMissionDTKey` `+0x38`, `LobbyName` `+0x48`, `ExpireTime`
  `+0x58`, `ProspectState` `+0x60`, `AssociatedMembers` `+0x68`
  (`FAssociatedMemberInfo`, `0x40` B: `AccountName` `+0x00`, `CharacterName`
  `+0x10`, `UserID` `+0x20`, `ChrSlot` `+0x30`, `Experience` `+0x34`, `Status`
  `+0x38`, `Settled` `+0x39`, `IsCurrentlyPlaying` `+0x3a`), `Cost` `+0x78`,
  `Reward` `+0x7c`, `Difficulty` `+0x80`, `Insurance` `+0x84`, `NoRespawns`
  `+0x85`, `ElapsedTime` `+0x88`, `SelectedDropPoint` `+0x8c` and
  `CustomSettings` `+0x90` (`0x18` B).
- Root fields (object offsets F-889): `Version` (integer tested by load
  fixups), `LobbyPrivacy` (enum, byte underlying descriptor), `ProspectInfo`
  (`FProspectInfo`), `ProspectMapName` (string), `LastSavedDateTime` (date/time),
  legacy strings `ProspectID` and `ProspectDTKey` (`0xd8`) for pre-version-2 fixups, and
  `StateRecorderBlobs` (`0xe8`, array of a derived state type).
- `StateRecorderBlob` layout: F-884; descriptor order is not serialized order
  (F-889, F-884).
- Dispatch uses tagged traversal (F-257, F-890, F-718; U-062 resolved):
  out-of-order tags wrap the property search; omissions keep defaults.
- Version (F-885, F-715; U-059, U-060 resolved; `migrate_prospect_save_state`):
  `Version = 2` is the schema version, unrelated to game build.
  `PostLoadSerialize` (`0x1418e4250` / `0x1418e44f0`) at `Version == 0` also sets
  `LobbyPrivacy = 1` (`FriendsOnly`), clears `StateRecorderBlobs` and stamps
  `Version = 2`.

Recorders and base component

- Recorder array and `BinaryData` framing: [tagged properties](tagged-properties.md)
  (F-883, F-257, F-884).
- Restore resolves and constructs the class; `+0x4a0` then reads tagged
  `CPF_SaveGame` properties, a 4-byte GUID-trailer boolean and the `+0x488`
  version-upgrade hook (addresses: F-890, F-891, F-909).

C013, C028, C034, C009 and D01

- `C013` (`UFLODRecorderComponent`; F-887, F-350..F-353, F-646, F-716; U-039
  resolved): base load, serialize and post-load; two 548-byte bodies
  (5 properties, zero trailer, exact EOF); record, stitch and restore of
  `FLODTiles` per F-716.
- `C028` (`UActorStateRecorderComponent` subclass; F-645, F-716; U-061
  resolved): `+0x4a0` calls `ApplyRecorderTransform` and `+0x488` upgrades
  `TreePrimitive` (addresses: F-716). Every body
  frames (F-259, F-655; binary `N01` 16 B / `N02` 12 B; F-116, F-123..F-141,
  F-363..F-374, F-720; U-030 resolved).
- `C034`: base load/serialize, `C028` post-load; 829 records per copy; fields
  and own struct array per F-664 and F-380, matching across builds
  (F-146..F-153, F-188, F-195, F-196, F-211, F-376..F-385, F-659, F-720; U-029,
  U-031 resolved).
- `C009` and `D01` (`FInventorySlotSaveData`; field counts and sizes F-386,
  F-387, F-167, F-203, F-655): `S02` `ArrayProperty<IntProperty>` + `Bool`, `S01`
  `Str` + `Int`; parents `PA01..PA04`/`PS01`; common `CA01` and `ND01`;
  `EDynamicItemProperties` `0..=13` on restore (F-155..F-203, F-386..F-400,
  F-728, F-735; U-020 resolved).

Acceptance conditions for any importer

- Stage, resolve and validate the full supported schema before publishing, with
  distinct errors, preserved source and native state, never an empty world, and
  unmapped content-dependent fields reported as incompatibility (F-771, F-269,
  F-403). Strict readers enforce binary transfer lengths and
  0/1 trailer booleans under explicit byte/element caps up to 1 MiB
  (F-134..F-200, F-888, F-346..F-382, F-891, F-900).

## Candidate

- `C001InertPlacementV1` accepts an explicitly bound authored fixture only
  (F-921; storage and limits: [authored-worlds runbook](../../runbooks/authored-worlds.md#spatial-worlds-and-inert-source-fixtures)).
  It requires source version 2, recorder version 3, exact C001 identity, neutral
  prospect behavior and complete one-to-one native placement coverage. Class,
  path, object-name and GUID bind exactly; no CRC-only dispatch, dropped record,
  partial result, respawn or stitching is admitted. The closed component fields
  are class/path/object-name, positive GUID, recorded version, false sublevel
  flag and complete transform, with optional supported find policy and false
  skip-owner flag; any other field rejects. Independently authored inert
  geometry has no variables, and native-frame coordinates transfer without
  conversion. Schema 5 keeps the preserved source and immutable identity,
  timestamp, root-presence and binding metadata beside mutable poses,
  cross-checked on reload. Original coordinates, official loadability and
  faithful save import stay unqualified.
- `DecodedImportCandidate` (F-920; limits:
  [native server](../../runbooks/native-server.md#supplied-saves)) retains
  migrated roots, exact recorder identities, decisions, optional typing and
  unchanged preserved bytes from one decode. The import plan reports
  `unresolved_prospect_info_enums` when a named or raw enum remains unknown
  after migration. Version 0 resets the prospect info before this check.
  Restoration adapters remain unqualified and native world publication stays disabled.
- Dry-run quest checks cover typed, retained recorders (synthetic F-1263).
  `recorders.rs` rejects duplicate top-level names and nonzero array
  indices before typing. Wrong types for the required `NameProperty` fields
  count toward `unexpected_recorder_row_field_types`. Absent fields, empty
  names and `None` add no references. C019 `QuestName` takes the first ASCII
  case-insensitive `D_Quests` match below index 65,535. C018
  `FactionMissionName` takes the first exact `D_FactionMissions` match at 0–255
  ([protocol](../network/world-managers.md#confirmed)). Both feed `data_row`
  counts and `unmapped_content`.
- Authored catalogs (formats 1 and 2) accept either table in `[row_tables]`
  as an array of up to 65,536 names (1–1,024 UTF-16 units), indexed from zero.
  When both sources supply rows, differing lengths or positions under table
  lookup rules count affected references in `conflicting_recorder_row_tables`.
  Ambiguous paths and rowless pak members leave references unmapped. Absent
  members permit authored coverage. Generic lookup scans flat `data_row`
  lists and all pak JSON tables by exact path, including duplicate filenames.
  Read or parse errors stop the scan.
- Native staging (`inspect-save --stage-check`):
  [envelope spec](prospect-envelope.md#candidate) (F-738).
- `import-save --dry-run` totals occupied and empty `container_positions`
  when all retained C016 lists are assessable (F-651). Negative lengths,
  conflicting declarations, duplicate or out-of-range positions in typed
  lists add `invalid_container_positions`. Untyped recorders still block.
- Retained exact C026 records enable count-only `character_container_links`.
  Explicit `AssociatedInventoryId` −1 (selector 13, F-1066) counts as
  `no_link`. With exactly one retained, assessable C016, nonnegative IDs
  count as `occupied`, `unoccupied` (gap) or `out_of_range` by
  `InventoryIndex` (default zero for a present entry).
  A qualified array with no link selector adds no count. Unsupported arrays,
  invalid selectors, duplicate or aliased selector 13, missing link values,
  IDs below −1 and nonnegative IDs without that manager count as `unknown_items`.
  Typing or inventory array failures count as `unknown_recorders`, slot array
  failures as `unknown_inventories`. Live links and owner binding remain open
  (U-069, U-045).
- Cross-build classes/defaults/overrides: [restore rules](restore-rules.md)
  (F-902); constructor provenance: [C001 digest](../../research/save-format/c001-constructor.md)
  (F-905..F-910).

## Open questions

- Original-server crash reproduction (U-047), supplied-save producing-build log
  confirmation (U-040), and native interpreted import / newer-build compatibility
  (U-025, U-045).

## Evidence

- Static: M-079..M-170, M-755..M-800; runtime: M-154, M-155, M-160; framing:
  M-049..M-118, M-172; C001: M-007..M-013, M-173, M-179..M-181, M-761, M-762.
- Tests: the [tagged-property suites](tagged-properties.md#evidence),
  `tests/save_format/restore_rules.rs`, `tests/cli.rs`.

# Recorder restoration rules

## Status

Experimental: pure rules in `experimental::restore_rules` and
`experimental::modifier_lifecycle` (`tests/save_format/restore_rules.rs`,
`tests/save_format/modifier_lifecycle.rs`, U-045; U-020..U-022, U-032, U-046,
U-048, U-050 resolved).
Last reconciled: 2026-11-19.

## Scope

Validation, stitching and restoration for 65 `/Script/Icarus.*RecorderComponent`
classes (`C001..C038`, `N001..N027`). F-660 excludes save decoding, class
lookup, object construction, script owners and data-table rows.
Rule docs give most addresses. Unmatched addresses stand alone or name a helper.

## Confirmed

- `ReadFromProspectSaveState` (F-741) validates, dispatches on `+0xb2`
  (`FindOnly` `0`, `RespawnOnly` `1`, `FindOrRespawn` `2`, `ManuallyResolved`
  `3`) and then stitches: F-1210.
- Restore dispatch and ctor defaults (`C001..C038`, `N001..N027`) match across
  server 25621760 and client 25793767 (F-902, F-904, F-746, F-747): inheritance
  F-1211; `C001..C038` flags `bSaveModifiers`, `bSkipDefaultOwnerResolution`,
  `+0xb2`, `bRecordModifierStates` and `bRecordActorTransform` F-1212, F-1213;
  `+0x470`/`+0x488` F-1214 and slot overrides F-1215 (F-716); `N001..N027`
  (`N012` `UIcarusJuvenileRecorderComponent`) F-1216 to F-1218.
- `Validate` (`+0x408`; F-652, F-663, F-680, F-904, F-747): base and
  `UProspectSubsystem` membership F-1219; `C011`/`N022` reset and `N018`
  `UNoRecorderComponent` F-1220; `C025`, `C026` and `C029` F-1221; `C028`
  `"Super_Cooled_Ice"` and subclass `N020` (`UResourceDepositIceRecorderComponent`)
  F-1222 (F-645, F-902); `C031`/`C034` voxels F-1223 (F-645).
- Stitching matches GUID plus ASCII `Stricmp` (F-663) per F-1224 (`C009` F-646;
  `C018`/`C019` F-650; `C027` F-676); GUID-only matches, `C013` `FLODTiles`
  cleanup and the `C026` life restore F-1225 (F-648, F-657, F-716).
- C016 saves length and occupied positions (F-651). Its 25621760 stitching
  slot selects a 2,963-byte routine (F-1266). Loop entry needs signed
  `saved_array_length - used_set_count > 0`. The receiver sets the loop bound.
  Used-index hits skip the call. Misses reach it only if other gates pass
  (F-1273). F-1267's dry run counts character links.
  The call takes a guarded field and zero-based counter. Assuming Win64
  register preservation a modeled skip permits a nonzero first index. The
  callee checks signed bounds (zero and the loop bound), reads an in-range
  64-bit slot and clears populated slots after opaque calls. Modeled normal
  in-range returns carry a storage base. Loop-back reloads its register
  independently. Modeled exits show no explicit caller use. Cleanup may
  preserve or clobber it.
- `DoesRecorderMatchActor` (`+0x478`, F-904) per class: F-1226.
- Per-class record, restore and transfer rules for `C002`..`C006`, `C008`..`C010`,
  `C012`, `C014`, `C020`..`C024`, `C030`, `C032`, `C033`, `C035`, `C036` and `C038`
  (F-657, F-744, F-677, F-646, F-661, F-658, F-648, F-656, F-894, F-736, F-734,
  F-903, F-676) live in `experimental::restore_rules`; function docs give both builds' addresses.
- C001 restoration follows F-735; C015 clocks/currencies/missions F-653;
  C037 world-boss rows F-903. Recorded level `-1` is unrecorded (F-648).
- `UIcarusGameStateRecorder` pipeline (F-750, F-902): `BeginRecording` F-1227
  to F-1229 (deferral while restoring, `RecorderComponents`, owner callbacks,
  `SpawnLocationToRecorderIndexMap`, `FlushDeferredRecorder`); `EndRecording`
  F-1230; `TryRestoreActorRecorder` and `ResolveOwnerRecorderState` F-1231;
  `HasValidOwner`, `RecordToProspectSaveState`, `RetainRecorder`,
  `PerformStitchingPass` and the `N001..N027` slot overrides F-1232.

- Saved row references and FLOD tile matching/respawn follow F-897; packaged
  row meanings remain excluded (F-660).
  Trace points: crop seeds `0x14196e790`, stomach modifiers `0x141890940`,
  FLOD name lookup `0x14189b800` and respawn `0x1418ac0f0`.
- Static-only modifier reload duration uses a distinct callback and role-`3`
  expiration wrappers issue reason-`0` `+0x3c0` (F-930, F-1233, F-1234). On
  primary `UModifierStateComponent`, matched slots, state data, stat scaling,
  scene attachment/ticks, tags/UIDs, lifetime rescaling and ordered activation
  follow F-930 and `experimental::modifier_lifecycle`
  (M-1027/ev_51aa536d68b6, M-1027/ev_c40e7a02c708,
  M-1027/ev_3681a1228c84, M-1027/ev_9785b53a7a36).
  Unresolved/non-`USceneComponent` attachment classes crash.
  Subclass/Blueprint overrides, downstream callee
  effects, owner/row binding and live execution remain unqualified.
- Server 25621760 declares a direct Boolean8 return (48), no declared this
  type (0) and direct signed Int32 (116) for modifier removal parameter
  three (F-1237, F-1238). Two debug-scope queries stopped at unsupported
  records (M-1603; M-1604/ev_3bf776a848de, M-1604/ev_25bb8f7c4be1).
  Its name and role as a UID remain open.
  F-1239 binds the pointer to forward `AActor`. Name and row-handle joins:
  F-1195, F-1235, F-1236, F-1240, F-1241.
  Framing: M-1454/ev_892924c04bd4, M-1454/ev_b213265d962e, M-1457,
  M-1458/ev_800189c44abc, M-1481/ev_ac1d9cdde283, M-1472 to M-1476.
  Actual receiver, return and argument ABI/storage, member extents, remaining
  signatures, effects, comparator associations, native owner, overrides,
  coordinates, lifetimes and runtime/client/import behavior remain open.
- `UIcarusFunctionLibrary::RemoveModifierState` local selection (F-937) is
  F-1242; F-940's helper and entry sampling F-1243; selected call operands
  F-1244; population strides and getters F-1245; `STORE8`/`LOAD8` preservation
  F-1246. M-1508 binds static checks. M-1509/M-1510 record processes only.
- The combined search hit its match cap (M-1540). In the selected server
  dispatch wrapper, a helper copies three eight-byte values to the stack
  argument passed in RDX to modifier removal (F-1260). The post-copy callee
  has no stores or calls. On its modeled normal return with `AL=1`, removal
  receives all 24 copied bytes. With `AL=0`, two more opaque calls can change
  them. Final bytes on that path, row and actor identity, other callers, native
  storage and runtime effects remain open.

## Candidate

- Float-to-int uses x86 truncation (`i32::MIN`); trig is approximate.

## Open questions

- Exact rebind-name lookup found no matches in the selected public-symbol
  profile (F-1266). Method, component, owner, aliases, outward return,
  candidate-to-saved-slot binding, call effect, historical/current restore and
  native import consequences remain open (F-1273).
- Data-table rows stay out of scope (F-660).

## Evidence

F-645..F-681, F-716, F-894, F-902..F-904, F-728, F-734..F-736, F-741..F-744, F-746, F-747,
F-750, F-897, F-930, F-937, F-940, F-1195; M-1425 to M-1428, M-1431 to M-1458, M-1471 to M-1476, M-1517; M-642..M-698, M-755..M-792, M-794..M-807, M-858, M-1024, M-1025,
M-1027, M-1028, M-1035..M-1037, M-1046..M-1048, M-1050, M-1052..M-1054, M-1058, M-1059, M-1061..M-1062, M-1065..M-1068, M-1071..M-1074.

# Tagged property and recorder framing

## Status

experimental; older-server build 25621760 profile `MemoryArchive522`, with bounded static comparison to client build 25793767. Last reconciled: 2026-10-22
Full text: d5b0ae6:docs/specs/save-format/tagged-properties.md

## Scope

Verified prospect framing: root tags, `StateRecorderBlobs`, and caller-selected
base-component, Int-array, tagged-struct-array and nested-struct (`read_root`)
framers. `MemoryArchive522` models build 25621760; it cannot identify the save's

- Tag record, in order (F-287):

  | Component | Encoding |
  | --- | --- |
  | Property name | Archive string; canonical `None` terminates the sequence |
  | Property type | Archive string, absent after the terminator |
  | Payload size | LE signed 32-bit byte count |
  | Array index | LE signed 32-bit value |
  | Type-specific metadata | see next bullet |
  | Property GUID presence | 1 byte; followed by 16 bytes when present |
  | Value | exactly the declared payload size |

  offset is not a file offset (F-291).

  leaves it opaque (F-292). Recorder array layout: F-884.

  in both copies: a serialization scalar, not the Steam build ID (F-885, F-715;

Reader policy (authored; research limits, not recovered format limits):

- Root: complete sequence ending in canonical `None` at exact EOF; input 32 MiB;
  4,096 root records; 1,024 units per header string including terminator; counts
  checked before allocating; negative, truncated, unsupported and noncanonical

  `UInt32Property`, `NameProperty`, `FloatProperty`, `TextProperty`,
  `ByteProperty`, `EnumProperty`, `BoolProperty`, `MapProperty`, `SetProperty`,

  exact EOF, terminal `None`, trailer flag `0` (rejecting GUID trailer `1`), and
  pre-allocation caps (32 MiB / 16,384 recorders / 65,536 fields; 64 KiB default
  up to 1 MiB `_with_limit` / 256 fields per component or struct element / 4,096
  elements; F-178, F-198, F-888, F-887, F-882, F-883, F-312, F-900).

ceilings every leaf of 15 prospects is a scalar, archive string, text frame,
tagged struct, one of the fixed engine structs, a scalar or struct array, or a
Map item, and re-encodes exactly (F-766).

- Recorders: 2,744 / 2,741 entries across 38 / 36 classes (all 36 shared at equal

A database-free standalone decoder passes its authored fixtures (F-907) and,

restoration (F-906, F-908, F-909, F-722, F-902, F-728, F-733, F-735; U-004,

`+0x4a0` reaches base `RestoreState` (F-722), which reads through
`FMemoryReader` at version 522, dispatches `Serialize` then `UpgradeVersion`
and may invoke `ApplyRecorderTransform` (`+0x4b0`, F-909);

# Evidence index

One JSON record per line per retained artifact. Rules:
[`.agents/rules/docs.md`](../.agents/rules/docs.md). Category folders mirror the
findings ledgers: a folder path joined with `-` names its ledger, active or
retired (`save-format/c001/` holds the evidence of `save-format-c001.md`). Each
folder holds `001.jsonl`, `002.jsonl`, ... with the highest open; its shards hold
only its own rows, not those of its subfolders. Fetch one row, never a shard:

```bash
grep -rhw --include='*.jsonl' M-NNN evidence/
python3 tools/docs_lint.py --next-id M
```

| Key | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | `M-NNN`, permanent |
| `path` | repository-relative path, anchor, or external locator |
| `sha256` | digest of the file's bytes, or null (legacy only) |
| `class` | `local-private`, `tracked` or `external` |
| `kind` | `rea-bundle`, `receipt`, `review`, `input`, `build`, `report`, `revision` |
| `date`, `label` | ISO date; label of at most 160 characters |
| `status` | `active`, `retired` or `missing` (needs `note` or `superseded_by`) |
| `ev`, `unk`, `records` | `rea-bundle` only: cited Evidence and unknown IDs, record count |
| `superseded_by`, `note`, `legacy` | optional; `legacy` marks M-001..M-270 |

A row naming a sha256 manifest pins every file it lists
(`.agents/rules/work.md`, `tools/sha256_manifest.py`).

Prose cites `M-NNN`, `M-NNN/ev_<12 hex>`, `M-NNN/unk_<12 hex>` or, for
pre-REA case notes, `M-NNN/E-NNN`.
